assessments.reasoning: Economic maintenance is captured separately at the individual member level for all household members aged 10 and older across labor earnings (Section I Question 17, Section J Question 19) and non-labor income sources including pensions, rents, and remittances (Section L Questions 2 and 4). Labor burden is captured at the member level through hours worked in paid employment (Section I Questions 52 and 54) as well as days and hours spent in unpaid domestic and care work (Section K Questions 1–6 and Section Q4 Questions 14–19). Property and asset control is not captured at member level, as dwelling tenure is asked at the aggregate household level (Section C Question 9). Decision-making in household spheres (such as child-rearing, daily consumption, or major financial choices) is not asked in the questionnaire; the only decision-making questions (Section I Questions 28–30) refer strictly to independent business operations.
